fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is mentioned as an alternative amid Nvidia (NVDA) uncertainty, but Nvidia's CUDA maintains an advantage over AMD's ROCm from a software perspective.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMD's Q3 data center revenue of $8.5 billion (97% increase year-over-year) is solid, but on a company-wide revenue basis of $13.4 billion (45% increase year-over-year), it is approximately 13x smaller than Nvidia's quarterly revenue in the $100 billion range.
fields.summary_ko.2: AMD's stock price is currently overvalued in the market, requiring caution in investment decisions.
